activity_summary: After the commination Master Thwaite said he had enjoyed reading it as it is written. Mistress Ansell called the hardness right and said the house is fish from this dinner. You did not ask for the reading again. You said the company is idle, the loaf is still a penny and a finger short, and you were going to look at a cold stage and not to play on it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Accepted the one reading, kept the loaf at a finger short, and said the house stays shut.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Owned the relish, and refused a second reading.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Set the house to fish, and told him not to come home with a story instead of an appetite.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Asked whether standing still was enough, and went to set the fish.

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: I have read it as it is written, and I am not sorry for the relish.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: The house is fish from this dinner.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am going to Shoreditch to look at a cold stage.

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: Evening prayer is evening prayer. It is not a second commination
